purpose: Define deterministic graph-operation classes for topology delta overlays.

add.definition: New Cook-scoped node or edge absent from baseline that does not alter existing baseline nodes or edges.

shadow.definition: Cook-local view override of an existing baseline node or route without mutating the baseline record.

rewrite.definition: Global mutation of a baseline node canonical definition or baseline-owned edge.

rebase.definition: Movement of a baseline node or subgraph to a different structural anchor or global order position.

delete.definition: Removal of a baseline node or edge from the effective graph outside a purely local view filter.

classifier_algorithm: Build effective overlay view E from baseline B plus overlay declarations O without mutating B.
If node or edge exists in E but not B and is Cook-scoped, classify as add.
If baseline-owned node has Cook-local override without baseline mutation, classify as shadow.
If baseline-owned canonical attributes mutate globally, classify as rewrite.
If baseline-owned parent or global order changes, classify as rebase.
If baseline-owned node or edge disappears from global effective view, classify as delete.
Reject every discovered operation outside add or shadow.
invariants: Every primitive change must classify as exactly one operation.
Cook may add only inside Cook scope.
Cook may shadow only inside Cook scope.
Cook may not rewrite, rebase, or delete baseline nodes or edges.
Baseline graph B must remain byte-preserved during overlay evaluation.
